notes.title: AereA - Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28124155/81a144ae23eeb95ea4494a829d3a98d228ed24fb.jpg[/img]
Hello, everyone!

We’re thrilled to share that [b][i]AereA[/i][/b] is back with a brand new update! [b]Version 1.0.3[/b] is now live on [b]Steam[/b], bringing a host of improvements, including balance adjustments for all heroes and enemies, plus fixes for bugs that disrupt the rhythm of your adventure.

We hope this update enhances your experience, and there’s plenty more on the way. Be sure to check out the full patch notes below for all the details!

Patch Notes: 
[list]
[*] Game balancing on all heroes and enemies.
[list]
[*]HitPoints and Max HitPoints.
[*]Damage given.
[*]Exp obtained.
[*]Cooldowns.
[*]Potion effects.
[/list]
[*] Fixed incorrect map display.
[*] Fixed collisions and boundaries.
[*] Fixed players getting locked in an area due to missing colliders.
[*] Fixed enemy clippings through walls/doors.
[*] Fixed blockers that don't allow player to progress.
[*] Fixed text, font and alignment in various scenarios.
[*] General bug fixes.
[/list]

Thanks,
-SOEDESCO

notes.title: Beta testers wanted for AereA! Win a free copy with your feedback
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Last year we released action RPG AereA. The game struggled with balancing issues and bugs that we’ve been wanting to fix ever since. Now, the time is finally here! We’ve prepared a major update for the game that can potentially fix a lot of the issues. However, we need your help to test this patch before we can launch it.

Please sign up [url=http://eepurl.com/dOl2oP]right here[/url] and in return we’ll give out AereA for free to 10 testers!

Your help is greatly appreciated and I hope we can finally make AereA the game it's supposed to be!

-Marten

notes.title: AereA now has Tobii eyetracking support!
notes.notes:
Today, an update was released for AereA which adds Tobii eyetracking support to the game.

Features include a dynamic UI which fades out when it's not looked at and a responsive camera that'll smoothly move to wherever you're looking, which increases immersion in the world of AereA!

notes.title: AereA - Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We've received your feedback and we’ve implemented a couple of changes especially regarding the balancing of the game. The new patch is online now! You can find the list of changes made below:

- Balancing of enemies at the start of the game
- Balancing of skills of all classes
- Fixed text at character selection screen
- Fixed text at shop screen
- Fixed controller input for locking character movement using the left stick press

We’d like to thank you, the community, for your feedback which made this patch possible! We’ll keep our eyes and ears open for more.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - AereA, 15% off!
notes.notes:
AereA is Now Available on Steam and is 15% off!*

AereA is an Action RPG in which music is both your best friend and your worst enemy. As a disciple of the Great Maestro Guido you have to unravel the mysteries of Aezir. Find out what happened to the world and return the nine primordial instruments to restore balance and bring peace to the world.

notes.title: Music themed RPG ‘AereA’ now available as timed exclusive on Steam
notes.notes:
Publisher SOEDESCO announced the surprise release of music themed action RPG AereA on Steam. As of today, the game is available as a timed Steam exclusive.

The Steam version of AereA launches with additional DLC in the form of the game’s Original Soundtrack by Broforce composer Deon van Heerden, and the AereA artbook.

AereA's artbook will be released episodically with more chapters added for free in the upcoming weeks!

notes.title: SOEDESCO cooperates with Broforce composer for AereA soundtrack
notes.notes:
Today publisher SOEDESCO announced that Broforce composer Deon van Heerden is working on the soundtrack for Action RPG AereA. They also announced a June 30 launch date for the game.

[b]Cooperation with Broforce composer[/b]
AereA is a music themed Action RPG in which the player explores Aezir, a floating island that was broken into pieces. To really tap into the music theme of the game, SOEDESCO cooperates with Broforce composer Deon van Heerden for the soundtrack. To add more music to the release, the boxed version of AereA includes the game’s original soundtrack as a special edition.

[b]Four playable characters[/b]
To celebrate the cooperation there’s an all-new trailer introducing AereA’s four heroes. Players get to play as Wolff the Harp-Archer, Jacques the Cello-Knight, Jules the Lute-Mage and Claude the Trumpet-Gunner. As disciples of Great Maestro Guido’s it’s their mission to find and return the nine primordial instruments to restore balance and peace in the world. Van Heerden composed a special soundtrack for this trailer.

notes.title: SOEDESCO announces new original IP
notes.notes:
Today publisher SOEDESCO announced a new original IP: AereA. The first game in the AereA-series is in development under the SOEDESCO brand and will be released later this year.

Adam’s Venture: Origins was the first IP released under the SOEDESCO brand. With AereA, the publisher adds an exciting new brand to its portfolio. The first title in the AereA-series is a music-themed action RPG in which the player goes on a quest to unravel the mysteries of the broken world of Aezir.

Hans van Brakel of SOEDESCO about the announcement: “Our strategy is to combine the publishing of third party games with first party titles. The AereA-IP is the next step in building a strong portfolio and a great addition to our 2017 line-up.”

The first game in the AereA-series is under development by Triangle Studios.
